Situation: As of 2026-10-21, levetiracetam inventory across the system totals 357 units. Corvale East holds 124 units at 6.8 units per day (18 days on hand). Corvale General holds 178 units at 7.8 units per day (23 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 55 units at 2.1 units per day (27 days on hand). The product label identifies Strides Pharma as the manufacturing plant for NDC 39328051130.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show levetiracetam is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current supply covers 18 to 27 days across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Proactive sourcing from alternative manufacturers is warranted to prevent future gaps.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (plant last inspected VAI 2023-10-13). Requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Hospira, Inc. (plant: HOSPIRA INC.). Requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Mylan Institutional LLC (plant: MYLAN LABS LTD.). Requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Novadoz Pharmaceuticals LLC (plant last inspected VAI 2023-12-21). Requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with UCB, Inc. (plant: UCB INC.). Requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical protocol adjustments at this time.
